faq.q: What does the Introduction to Safety Procedures for Water Damage Work course cover?
faq.a: This course provides technicians with the practical protocols to assess hazards, select PPE, control exposures, and manage equipment safely in every water damage scenario.

faq.q: What is the focus of the Introduction to Safety Procedures for Water Damage Work course?
faq.a: Water damage restoration creates a unique combination of overlapping hazards — electrical, biological, chemical, physical, and ergonomic — that can escalate rapidly if not managed with structured safety procedures.
